top_signals.title: Shapoorji Seeks Bond Payment Delay as Tata Listing Takes Shape
top_signals.summary: India’s Shapoorji Pallonji Group, the conglomerate behind the country’s biggest private credit deal, is in talks with lenders to one of its units to extend a bond payment due at the end of September, according to people familiar with the matter.
